sn6.14:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn6.14:2.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave rājā ahosi aruṇavā nāma.
sn6.14:2.2: rañño kho pana bhikkhave aruṇavato aruṇavatī nāma rājadhānī ahosi.
sn6.14:2.3: aruṇavatiṃ kho pana bhikkhave rājadhāniṃ sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho upanissāya vihāsi.
sn6.14:2.4: sikhissa kho pana bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa abhibhūsambhavaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi. aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
sn6.14:2.5: atha kho bhikkhave sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho abhibhuṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi:
sn6.14:2.6: āyāma brāhmaṇa yena aññataro brahmaloko tenupasaṅkamissāma, yāva bhattassa kālo bhavissati.
sn6.14:2.7: evaṃ bhanteti kho bhikkhave abhibhū bhikkhu sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paccassosi.
sn6.14:2.8: atha kho bhikkhave sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho abhibhū ca bhikkhu seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva aruṇavatiyā rājadhāniyā antarahitā tasmiṃ brahmaloke pāturahesuṃ.
sn6.14:3.1: atha kho bhikkhave sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho abhibhuṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi:
sn6.14:3.2: paṭibhātu taṃ brāhmaṇa brahmuno ca brahmaparisāya ca brahmapārisajjānañca dhammī kathāti.
sn6.14:3.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho bhikkhave abhibhū bhikkhu sikhīssa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭissutvā brahmānañca brahmaparisañca brahmapārisajje ca dhammiyā kathāya saṃdassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
sn6.14:3.4: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
sn6.14:3.5: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho, kathaṃ hi nāma satthari sammukhībhūte sāvako dhammaṃ desessatīti.
sn6.14:4.1: atha kho bhikkhave sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho abhibhuṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi:
sn6.14:4.2: ujjhāyanti kho te brāhmaṇa brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca.
sn6.14:4.3: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho, kathaṃ hi nāma satthari sammukhībhūte sāvako dhammaṃ desessatīti.
sn6.14:4.4: tena hi tvaṃ brāhmaṇa bhiyyosomattāya brahmānañca brahmaparisañca brahmapārisajje ca saṃvejehīti.
sn6.14:4.5: evaṃ bhanteti kho bhikkhave abhibhū bhikkhu sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭissutvā dissamānenapi kāyena dhammaṃ desesi. adissamānena pi kāyena dhammaṃ desesi. dissamānenapi heṭṭhimena upaḍḍhakāyena adissamānenapi uparimena upaḍḍhakāyena dhammaṃ desesi. dissamānenapi uparimena upaḍḍhakāyena adissamānena pi heṭṭhimena upaḍḍhakāyena dhammaṃ desesi.
sn6.14:4.6: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca acchariyabbhutacittajātā ahesuṃ:
sn6.14:4.7: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho, samaṇassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatāti.
sn6.14:5.1: atha kho bhikkhave abhibhū bhikkhu sikhiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etadavoca:
sn6.14:5.2: abhijānāmi khvāhaṃ bhante bhikkhusaṅghassa majjhe evarūpaṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā,
sn6.14:5.3: pahomi khvāhaṃ āvuso brahmaloke ṭhito sahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpetunti.
sn6.14:5.4: etassa brāhmaṇa kālo etassa brāhmaṇa kālo
sn6.14:5.5: yaṃ tvaṃ brāhmaṇa brahmaloke ṭhito sahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpeyyāsi.
sn6.14:5.6: evaṃ bhanteti kho bhikkhave abhibhū bhikkhu sikhīssa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭissutvā brahmaloke ṭhito imā gāthāyo abhāsi:
sn6.14:8.1: atha kho bhikkhave sikhī ca bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho abhibhū ca bhikkhu brahmānañca brahmaparisañca brahmapārisajje ca saṃvejetvā
sn6.14:8.2: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva tasmiṃ brahmaloke antarahitā aruṇavatiyā rājadhāniyā pāturahesuṃ.
sn6.14:8.3: atha kho bhikkhave sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhikkhū āmantesi:
sn6.14:8.4: assuttha no tumhe bhikkhave abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassāti.
sn6.14:8.5: assumha kho mayaṃ bhante abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassāti.
sn6.14:8.6: yathā kathaṃ pana tumhe bhikkhave assuttha abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassāti.
sn6.14:8.7: evaṃ kho mayaṃ bhante assumha abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassa:
sn6.14:11.1: evaṃ kho mayaṃ bhante assumha abhibhussa bhikkhuno, brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassāti.
sn6.14:11.3: sādhu kho tumhe bhikkhave assuttha abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassāti.
sn6.14:12.1: idamavoca bhagavā. attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
